HOW IT WORKS

From intent to verification.

AFWE works with your AI agents to make sure changes respect your architecture, constraints and recorded decisions.

The 3-step process →
1

Begin

The agent receives scoped context from your codebase — architecture, active pins, invariant rules, and declared claims.

afwe turn begin "..."
2

Assume

The agent proposes structural changes, declaring intent and exact AST claims before editing any source code.

afwe turn assume <turn>
3

Commit

AFWE deterministically gates the commit against your constraints and pins, creating an audit receipt trailer.

afwe turn commit <turn>
WHY AFWE

More than dependency maps.

Traditional tools show you what's connected. AFWE shows you what's allowed, what's intended, and how it all fits together over time.
